caseStudies.role: Freelance social media manager, June 2026 to present
caseStudies.headline: From local favorite to a sundae people order by name
caseStudies.card: Helped drive a 10% sales lift and 143K new followers in five months.
caseStudies.summary: Cabot's is a family ice cream shop outside Boston with a loyal local crowd, a small social following and no TikTok. I cast the real staff, opened every video with a question and built each one around an over-the-top sundae, then launched TikTok from zero.

results.text: sales, June to October 2026 vs. the same months in 2025, with about 7% more guests
TikTok followers, and about 143K new followers across Instagram, Facebook and TikTok
views and 185K+ shares on the Chocolate Homicide Reel. Customers now order it by name

video.caption: "What's the best sundae for chocolate lovers?" 14.8M views across platforms

caseStudies.extraNote: Instagram views up 5,200% to 39.5M since June 2026. A second Reel reached 11.0M views.

about.headline: Hi, I'm Greer.
paragraphs: I turn scrollers into customers. The brands I've managed have earned 200M+ views, sending people to book trips, walk through the door and buy what they saw online.

I've spent 6+ years in social media across travel, food and beverage, and lifestyle brands, from launching Harpoon Brewery's TikTok to managing content as Associate Social Media Manager at EF Go Ahead Tours. Outside EF, I run social for local businesses.

I'm a social media manager who is also comfortable on camera, so strategy, filming, editing and posting all live with one person. Off the clock, I'm usually exploring a new city or planning my next trip, which is probably why travel, hospitality and lifestyle are where I do my best work.
